description: This file defines the SortOption interface, which represents a sorting option for search results, including methods to create, modify, and retrieve sort entries.

classes.name: SortOption
classes.description: An interface representing an immutable sorting option with methods to manage sort entries.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SortOption instance from a list of SortOptionEntry objects.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the sort entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new sort property with specified order, returning a new SortOption instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a provided SortOptionEntry to the sort options, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of sort entries.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the sort options contain any entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of the sort entries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the sort option.
